intro.text:
Flow past a cylinder at Reynolds number 200.

Watch the wake start to wobble and then shed alternating vortices.

outro.text:
A new vortex leaves every 2.5 s, alternating sides (Strouhal number 0.20, as in published results).

OpenFOAM pimpleFoam · 2D laminar, Re = 200

captions.text: Fluid flows left to right past a cylinder. Colours show where it spins.
At first the wake is calm: two spinning layers trail behind, mirror images of each other.
Tiny disturbances grow. The wake starts to wobble, and vortices peel off one side, then the other.
Now the pattern repeats like clockwork: a von Kármán vortex street.
Each vortex tugs the cylinder sideways, so the side force swings back and forth every 5 s.
The same effect makes power lines hum and tall chimneys sway in the wind.
